annotations.title: Re-check a page against an earlier receipt: unchanged, changed, gone or unreadable

description: Reports if a page changed since a receipt: unchanged, changed, gone, unreadable. US$0.003 per call; POST receipt, URL. Costs US$0.003 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/recheck

content_sha256.description: Only with url: the page.content_sha256 from our own fetch (64 hex). Other tools hash other text.

history.description: Optional: up to 10 earlier receipts of this service for the same url, oldest first (fetch, verify/quote or recheck; paid or trial). Adds a timeline. Not stored.

quote.description: Only with a verify/quote receipt in exact or fuzzy mode: the quote exactly as it was sent to verify/quote. Must match the one the receipt signed. We re-test it on the live page and answer quote.verdict: still_exact, now_exact, now_fuzzy, now_missing or unchecked.

quotes.description: Only with a verify/quotes receipt in exact or fuzzy mode: all of its quotes, exactly as sent to verify/quotes, in the same order. Each must match the one the receipt signed. We re-test each on the live page and answer quotes[i].verdict (same values as quote.verdict). Not with quote.

receipt.description: Compact JWS receipt from an earlier /v1/fetch, /v1/verify/quote, /v1/verify/quotes or /v1/recheck call of this service (paid or trial; not a sample). Max 160 KB.

return_text.description: Also return up to 20,000 characters of the new clean text. Default false.

url.description: Only without receipt: the http(s) URL to re-check (max 2,048 characters).

name: attestpage_recheck

baseline.description: The baseline compared against; receipt_sha256 links a chain of recheck receipts.

page.description: The new fetch, as /v1/fetch gives it.

timeline.description: Only with history: each history receipt, then this check; changed compares clean-text hashes with the entry before.
